cases.title: You are a college student seeking financial assistance and s
cases.rawInput: "I am 21 years old, studying engineering, my family income is low, and I need financial help for my education."

result.situation: You are a college student seeking financial assistance and scholarship opportunities to support your higher education expenses.
result.intent: Identify verified scholarship schemes, clarify income & category requirements, and prepare for online application.

whatMayHelp.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
whatMayHelp.description: Central government platform hosting Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, and Merit-cum-Means schemes across Central Ministries.
whatMayHelp.whyRelevant: Designed for students enrolled in recognized higher education courses with family income below statutory thresholds.

whatMayHelp.title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
whatMayHelp.description: Department of Higher Education scheme providing financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families.
whatMayHelp.whyRelevant: Direct benefit transfer for college tuition support based on board examination percentile.

whatMayHelp.title: AICTE Pragati / Saksham / Post-Graduate Scholarships
whatMayHelp.description: Technical education grants for girl students, differently-abled scholars, and engineering degree students.
whatMayHelp.whyRelevant: Applicable if studying in an AICTE-approved technical or engineering institution.

whyRelevant: Your student status makes you eligible to explore merit-cum-means and post-matric fee reimbursement schemes.
Your reported income bracket places you within standard eligibility tiers for government educational subsidies.
Both Central (NSP) and State portals offer recurring annual grants directly deposited into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
informationStillNeeded: Your State of domicile / residence (state scholarship schemes vary significantly).
Approximate annual family income (most need-based schemes require under ₹2.5 Lakhs/year).
Caste / Category (General / OBC / SC / ST / Minority / EWS).
Current course and year of study (e.g., 2nd Year B.Tech / B.Sc).

actions.title: Check National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Eligibility
actions.description: Visit scholarships.gov.in and browse 'Central Schemes' and 'State Schemes' matching your course and domicile.
actions.reason: Direct registration ensures you receive application alerts before seasonal deadlines expire.

actions.title: Obtain Verified Revenue Income Certificate
actions.description: Apply through your local citizen service center (e.g., Nadakacheri in Karnataka / CSC) or revenue department to obtain a certified digital income certificate.
actions.reason: Statutory scholarship schemes require a valid digital income certificate with an active verification barcode.

actions.title: Link and Seed Your Bank Account with Aadhaar (DBT Enabled)
actions.description: Confirm with your bank branch that your savings account is NPCI-mapped for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
actions.reason: Government scholarship grants are disbursed exclusively via Aadhaar-linked NPCI payment bridge.

actions.title: Collect College Bonafide & Previous Marksheets
actions.description: Request a Bonafide Student Certificate and fee receipt from your college administrative office.
actions.reason: Required during document verification stage to confirm ongoing enrollment and academic standing.

documentsNeeded: Aadhaar Card (matching name on school records)
Valid Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority / Tehsildar
Previous Year / Semester Marksheets with passing grades
College Admission Fee Receipt & Bonafide Certificate
Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook (showing Account No. & IFSC)
Caste / Domicile Certificate (if applicable for reserved quotas)
importantInfo: All government scholarship portals (NSP, SSP) are completely FREE to apply — never pay middlemen or unofficial brokers.
Applications usually open around August-October and close around November-December each academic year.
Ensure your name, date of birth, and parents' names match exactly between Aadhaar and academic marksheets to prevent portal rejection.
result.recommendedNextStep: 👉 Check the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) to verify if fresh application windows are currently active for your course.
result.refinementPrompt: Tell us your State and family income below so we can pin down exact state schemes and eligibility criteria.
verified: User is currently pursuing higher education.
User is actively seeking financial scholarship support.

resources.description: Central government portal administering nationwide educational assistance.

resources.type: State Higher Education & Social Welfare Department
resources.description: State nodal agency for state-specific tuition reimbursement.

warnings: SAHAAYA provides decision-support information and does NOT approve scholarships or disburse funds.
Always verify application status directly on official .gov.in portals.

cases.title: A 67-year-old patient is experiencing a reported severe bloo
cases.rawInput: My father is 67. He has old prescriptions and medical reports. Today his blood pressure reading is 190/110 and he is dizzy. We are stuck in traffic while trying to reach a hospital.

result.situation: A 67-year-old patient is experiencing a reported severe blood pressure reading of 190/110 mmHg with dizziness, while in transit to an emergency hospital during severe traffic congestion.
result.intent: Secure immediate acute medical evaluation, safely manage in-transit hypertensive symptoms, and reach hospital care despite traffic impediments.

detectedInformation.label: Available Records
detectedInformation.value: Historical prescriptions and medical reports present

detectedInformation.label: Logistical Obstacle
detectedInformation.value: Vehicle trapped in dense traffic en route

verified: Patient is reported as 67 years old with reported BP reading of 190/110 mmHg.
Caregiver reports patient is experiencing dizziness.
Past medical documentation is currently with the caregiver.
Transit is obstructed by road traffic.
needsConfirmation: Presence of severe red-flag indicators (chest tightness, acute shortness of breath, slurred speech, limb weakness, or vision changes).
Recent antihypertensive drug compliance, dosages, and administration timing.
Exact GPS coordinates and proximity to the nearest open emergency cardiac department.
Whether emergency medical dispatch has been requested for siren escort / paramedic interception.

actions.title: Contact Emergency Medical Dispatch Immediately
actions.description: Call local emergency services (dial emergency number) to request an emergency paramedic vehicle or lane escort if vehicle movement is completely halted.
actions.reason: Paramedics possess siren transit priority and can administer in-transit stabilization if condition deteriorates.

actions.title: Keep Patient Seated, Calm, and Well-Ventilated
actions.description: Ensure the individual stays in a relaxed, seated upright posture without sudden standing or head movements. Loosen restrictive collar clothing.
actions.reason: Minimizes sudden postural pressure shifts, fall risk, and reduces physical exertion.

actions.title: Organize Prescriptions and Identification for Intake
actions.description: Place all historical prescriptions and reports within arm's reach for immediate handover to triage physicians.
actions.reason: Enables emergency physicians to evaluate chronic medication histories rapidly without dangerous drug interaction hazards.

resources.description: Local official emergency paramedic services for transit assistance.
Nearest accredited tertiary medical facility with active acute emergency triage.
Local traffic management for emergency corridor clearance in severe gridlock.

warnings: DO NOT administer borrowed or unprescribed blood pressure pills without direct physician direction; rapid drops in blood pressure can precipitate cerebral hypoperfusion.
SAHAAYA provides decision-support structure and does NOT issue medical diagnoses or replace licensed clinical evaluation.
If the patient exhibits sudden facial weakness, arm drift, or speech changes, communicate potential stroke symptoms to dispatch immediately.
